finding: The ordinary LibreCAD filter refused even the previously checked same-version AC1021 sparse-material graph; a first prototype could save it but could not reopen and resave LibreCAD's own default-space and plot-settings output.
change: Admit ordinary replay only for bounded ASCII AC1021 input with a complete physical identity inventory and selected simple model-space LINE records. Validate physical fields, delivered geometry, default appearance, reference identity, graph closure and the existing staged-output checks.

For an output reread, admit only the exact generated default model/paper block-record and paired empty BLOCK/ENDBLK shapes; validate the generated default PLOTSETTINGS source bytes and typed projection. Source input is prescanned once and retained only for possible MATERIAL files at or below the existing 256 KiB bound.

Before publishing, recheck that live entities and active plot settings remain within this profile; unsupported edits and source shapes refuse without replacing the destination. The explicit wider experimental replay policy remains separately guarded.

validation.focused: macOS ARM64 with the installed standalone codec: 9906 assertions in 19 MATERIAL and IMAGE cases pass. The bundled-codec filter translation unit compiles. The controls cover initial save, a separate writer, reopen/resave, material-bearing and unlinked line edits, cross-version refusal, unsupported entity/field/block/plot forms, physical identity collision or mismatch, omitted callbacks, destination preservation, late mutation and corrected retry.
validation.peer: ezdxf 1.4.5 independently read the initial save, resave and edited resave. In each, the first LINE, layer, header and ACAD_MATERIAL dictionary named the same PlainMat; the edited resave retained endpoints (12,0,0) and (20,1,0) for its two lines. Each audit had zero errors and fixes.

limits: This is an experimental locally authored profile, not general MATERIAL, DXF, DWG or native-platform parity. Binary and other versions, nondefault plot settings, other entity types, custom blocks, unrelated source fields and unknown references remain refused on the ordinary raw-material route.
The 256 KiB source bound is unchanged. Additional source observers retain bounded inventories; broader files and aggregate-memory expansion require separate qualification.
Four existing handle-selector cases still expect broader unqualified sparse-MATERIAL output. No drawing fixture was committed.
